# Madeira Originals

> Madeira Originals apparel from São Vicente, Madeira. T-shirts, hoodies, accessories and stickers inspired by island culture. 0% tourist trap.

Madeira Originals is the apparel brand at https://madeiraoriginals.pt. Studio services have moved to the separate Madeira Studio site at https://madeirastudio.pt. Legacy service pages remain available with a notice linking to the studio site.

## Languages

The site is bilingual and uses path-based locales:

- Portuguese (pt-PT) is the default and lives at the root — e.g. `/shop`.
- English lives under an `/en` prefix — e.g. `/en/shop`.
- Slugs are identical in both trees; only the prefix changes.
- Legacy `?lang=en` / `?lang=pt` URLs redirect to their path-based equivalent.

The page list below shows the Portuguese (root) URLs. Prefix any of them with `/en` for the English version.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Brand overview and featured collections.
- [Shop](/shop): Full apparel catalogue.
- [Madeira T-Shirts](/madeira-t-shirts): Ring-spun cotton tees with island-rooted graphics.
- [Madeira Hoodies](/madeira-hoodies): Atlantic-weight hoodies built for Madeira's microclimates.
- [Madeira Accessories](/madeira-accessories): Caps, totes, beanies, and small island essentials.
- [Madeira Stickers](/madeira-stickers): Durable die-cut UV DTF stickers.
- [Madeira Streetwear](/madeira-streetwear): The full apparel line.
- [Madeira Gifts](/madeira-gifts): Curated gift selection from Madeira.
- [Studio services](https://madeirastudio.pt): Design, apparel printing, vinyl and signage on the separate studio site.
- [Wholesale](/wholesale): Trade and distributor programme.
- [Culture](/culture): Stories and inspiration from Madeira.
- [About](/about): Brand story, values, and team.
- [Studio contact](https://madeirastudio.pt): Contact the studio on its separate site; the legacy /contact page remains available with a move notice.
- [Journal](/journal): Articles on Madeira culture, design, and apparel.
